title: UC model load and register must both gate on the Databricks SDK models artifact repo flag
answers: How do I make Unity Catalog model load and register use the Files API instead of vended tokens?
Why does load_model work but register_model still uses scoped credentials on Unity Catalog?
body:
Invariant: UC model download (load) and UC model upload (register) must both check MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC at the top of their _get_artifact_repo, before any scoped-token fetch. The flag is read at call time and defaults to False.
Enforced by: mlflow/store/artifact/unity_catalog_models_artifact_repo.py:UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo (load, passes self.registry_uri) and mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry/rest_store.py:UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo (register, passes self.store_uri; reached from create_model_version).
What breaks if skipped: gating only one path leaves that path on vended tokens, which Unity Catalog blocks. Flag-off must keep the scoped-credential behavior unchanged.
Constraints: the URI passed as registry_uri/store_uri is what lets the workspace client resolve host and token; drop it and creds resolution falls back to default auth.
applies: Any change to UC model-registry artifact download or upload routing in mlflow/store/artifact and mlflow/store/_unity_catalog/registry.
says: Registering a new model version in Unity Catalog fails due to blocked cloud credentials.
Loading registered models works but saving new versions still gets rejected by the catalog.
Switch model catalog uploads and downloads to use direct file storage instead of tokens.
Catalog model registration fails authentication when short-lived storage tokens are disallowed by policy.
search: Both Unity Catalog model download (load) and upload (register) paths must check the MLFLOW_USE_DATABRICKS_SDK_MODEL_ARTIFACTS_REPO_FOR_UC environment variable at call time before fetching scoped tokens. This invariant is enforced in UnityCatalogModelsArtifactRepository._get_artifact_repo (passing self.registry_uri) and UcModelRegistryStore._get_artifact_repo (passing self.store_uri during create_model_version). If either path omits the check, it reverts to vended tokens blocked by Unity Catalog, while keeping the flag disabled preserves default scoped-credential behavior. Omitting registry_uri or store_uri causes workspace client credential resolution to fall back to default authentication.
